definitions.straightRunCells: Serialized geometry run lengths in steps; nearest-rank p90.
definitions.length: Sum of serialized centerline run lengths in steps.
definitions.reuseFraction: Engine reusedCells divided by corridor cell count; aggregate sums per-route counts, preserving overlap occurrences and corridor width.
definitions.boundaryFraction: Centerline point occurrences at distance <=2 from a window edge, excluding Manhattan distance <=3 from either endpoint of that route.
definitions.junctionDegree: External centerline graph edges leaving serialized contact area; also route count and maximum cell degree.
definitions.alternativesUsefulness: Server usefulness flags plus distance improvement and new-cell fraction; no inferred acceptance rule.
definitions.siteConnectionIntentStatusCounts: Server intent statuses filtered to purpose SiteConnection, including requests without materialized attachments. Availability is explicit because older fixtures may omit intents.
definitions.primary: Primary-routes checkpoint, or site-connections when no primary checkpoint exists.
